excerpt_i18n.en: On November 4, the highly anticipated AI model real-time investment competition "Alpha Arena" concluded, with Alibaba's Qwen emerging as the ultimate champion. Organized by the third-party institution Nof1 on October 18, the contest gathered six top global models—Qwen3-Max, DeepSeek v3.1, GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Grok 4—each starting with $10,000 in initial capital to make autonomous decisions and trades in real markets without human intervention, determining the winner based on profit and loss. The "Alpha Arena" released by the U.S. AI research lab nof1.ai provided the six top models with $10,000 and real-time market prices and various indicators, allowing them to compete with real money in actual markets without any human intervention, enabling autonomous decision-making and trading by AI.

While generative AI offers unprecedented creative capabilities, the process is still fragmented. Creators must first write scripts, then use text-to-video tools to generate visuals, followed by handling voiceovers, editing, subtitles, pacing, and more—each step relying on different software. Professional teams can streamline these stages with workflows, but for average creators, such division often means more time and learning effort. AI makes starting creation easier but hasn't made it more seamless. The real breakthrough may not be bigger models or stronger computing power, but enabling AI to truly understand creativity and participate in creation. Only when these scattered steps are reconnected can creativity flow naturally. The future of AI video creation may not lie in adding more tools but in forming a unified system where text, images, and sound collaborate in one space, and ideation, generation, and adjustments happen in the same context. Now, Kunlun Tech is gradually realizing this change. Introducing the new SkyReels: Seamless Creation. Kunlun Tech's latest SkyReels is born from this vision of redefining creation. It's not just another standalone generation tool but a multimodal system that restores creation to unity and flow. In the new SkyReels, elements like images, videos, music, and voice narration are all integrated.

Building on a pre-trained SSL encoder, we fine-tune only the semantic token embedding and pair it with a generative decoder trained jointly using a standard flow matching objective.
